body.name: W_hat_loc
body.construction: For a fixed regular population branch \(W\), minimize \(\lVert F_{\mathrm{res}}(U;\widehat z)\rVert_2^2\) over any fixed closed Frobenius ball centered at \(W\) that contains no other raw branch, and denote its unique local minimizer by \(\widehat W_{\mathrm{loc}}\).
